paragraphs.text:
You tell the man you’re a doctor, sent by the coroner to look 
into Prof. Harris’ death. The man nods slowly, mournfully. “Ah, 
that’s a bad business. I liked the old man. Can’t say I know much 
about his death though. You’ll want to talk to Officer Powell about 
that. Or maybe his widow, Amelia. They’ll probably be at that estate 
sale tonight. Without Professor Harris around, she’ll need the extra 
windfall if she plans to stay in Esbury. This place ain’t cheap.” The 
man brushes his hand against his shirt and then extends it to 
you. “My name’s Lance, by the way. Lance Sanford. Good to meet 
you, but I wish it was under happier circumstances.”
• To inquire about Prof. Harris, go to 27.
• To inquire about Officer Powell, go to 36.
• To ask Lance Sanford about himself, go to 42.
• To ask about the estate sale, go to 66.
• To ask about the widow Amelia, go to 89.
• To pass the time waiting to arrive in Esbury, go to 56.
